mapper.select: SELECT A.PRODUCT_ID, A.USER_NO, A.TITLE, A.DESCRIPTION, A.PRICE, A.CATEGORY_GROUP, A.CATEGORY_MID, A.CATEGORY_SCLS, A.SALE_STATUS, A.REGISTER_NO, A.REGIST_DT, A.UPDUSR_NO, A.UPDT_DT, (SELECT IMAGE_URL FROM tb_product_image WHERE PRODUCT_ID= A.PRODUCT_ID AND REPRESENT=1) AS IMAGE_URL FROM tb_product A WHERE A.SALE_STATUS = #{saleStatus}
